exposure: preparedness for birth and complications readiness
outcome: completion of maternity continuum of care
cohort: The study included 625 postpartum women who had given birth in the previous six months in the Gedeb district of Gedio Zone, southern Ethiopia.
finding: Only 32% of postpartum women completed the maternal continuum of care, with higher education, ANC counseling, birth preparedness, and good knowledge of pregnancy danger signs being significant positive predictors.
